name: Naruto: The Trials of Menma
source:
Naruto: Trials of Menma is a visual novel that reimagines the early days of Konoha. Step into the role of Menma, Naruto’s enigmatic counterpart, and carve your own path as you:
• Engage in dynamic battles against rival shinobi
• Uncover hidden truths lurking in the shadows of the Leaf
• Decide your destiny – will you forge bonds of friendship or descend into darkness?
• Shape the future of the shinobi world through the choices you make
Your journey will define everything.
Will you walk in Naruto’s light… or Menma’s shadow?
translation:
《火影忍者：面麻的试炼》（Naruto: The Trials of Menma）是一部重新构想木叶隐村早期岁月的视觉小说。踏入鸣人那位神秘镜像“面麻”的视角，亲手开辟属于你自己的忍者之道：
• 与宿敌忍者展开扣人心弦的激烈交锋
• 揭开潜伏在木叶暗影深处的隐秘真相
• 主宰自身命运——你是会缔结友情的羁绊，还是就此堕入黑暗？
• 借由你做出的每一个抉择，重塑整个忍界的未来
你的旅途将决定一切。
你究竟会行于鸣人的光明之中……还是踏入面麻的暗影深处？
